parameter_summary: Delete exactly the current 10 Git-tracked files below the repository-local .reasonix directory, remove the resulting empty directory, and add only /.reasonix/ to the root .gitignore.
conditions: Resolve the target inside the current repository and require it to equal the repository-local .reasonix directory before deletion.
Require the recursive filesystem inventory to equal the 10-path Git tracked inventory and contain no unknown untracked files immediately before deletion.
Delete no path outside .reasonix and change no business file except the root .gitignore.
Treat the first deletion attempt as consuming this authorization; do not retry against a changed inventory or another subject.
Preserve a task-local receipt with the approved action digest, deleted tracked path list, parent commit, and recovery method.
Do not push, merge, deploy, publish, export credentials, call external models or paid services, or perform any external action.
